extracted.name: My go-to Chocolate Chip Cookies
extracted.description: Here's my go-to, fail-proof (so far), chocolate chip cookies that's, for some reason, senior citizen approved If you want your cookies to be on the crispier, harder side, cook for 13 mins. If, like me, you want your cookies to be chewy, cook for 12 mins to 12 mins and 30 seconds. Of course, this depends on how consistent your oven temp is.
instruction_lines: Add 1 cup of sifted flour, together with the salt and baking soda. Mix until combined
Add in the remaining all-purpose flour and mix in the chocolate chips.
